purpose: Rule-11 registered adversarial falsification of the mass-action law (T051's e097 amendment): recency / readership / greedy-oracle subset selection vs the random control band at k in {64, 128}, on the e089/e097 dynamic instrument VERBATIM (crossing-time progressive V-zero, matched-stream continuation, clean-net final-64 tail judgment). Kill bar: any adversarial k=64 arm CI-backed above the random k=128 band => selection beats mass. Law-stands bar: all arms below the random k=128 band AND greedy-recency within 1.5x random-at-same-k => mass first-order, selection second-order.

arms.random: 10 draws per k; rng default_rng(101); e089 rule VERBATIM (choice(band, k, replace=False), reject & redraw while min > 350; rejections tallied); run = (arm_index*10 + draw) % 8
arms.greedy_recency: the k NEWEST REMOVABLE entries = positions 413-k+1..413 (414 unremovable-by-construction in every arm — e089's edge case; k_eff = k); deterministic -> 8 draws = the 8 run-streams
arms.top_readership: per run, the k band positions with highest accumulated attention received over the control free run (e085/e070 instrument: mean over heads, summed over layers, accumulated over all decode steps — oracle-grade full-run prior, maximally favorable to selection); deterministic per run -> 8 draws
arms.adversarial_greedy: REPORT-ONLY k=16 oracle: pool = top-16 readership U 16 newest U 8 rng(1010) random band entries; ANCHORED at pool-min (all sets share min -> one batched group; entries below pool-min unreachable — conservative); 15 greedy steps of batched argmax marginal damage; run = the random-k64-max run (adversarial direction)

timing.schedule: per-entry age-97-crossing V-zero (e089/e097 VERBATIM, no adaptations)
timing.t_int: min(S) + 97 (the earliest entry's crossing = the forced decode)
timing.exposure: 414 - min(S) (>= 64 for random/recency arms by construction; reader arms keep their verbatim top-k with min documented)
timing.unremovable: p = 414 crosses at 511, beyond the last decode (510): never zeroed, stays live, k_eff = k-1 (can only occur in random arms here)

protocol.arms_instrument: 2 per group, SAME continuation seed (matched streams): control / crossing-time progressive removal of the subset
protocol.outcome: clean-judge tail CE (448..511) of removal stream minus matched control stream; arm MEAN over draws

bars.kill_bar_A: any adversarial arm at k=64: mean > random k=128 mean AND ratio cluster-CI lower > 1.0 (resamples with denominator <= 0.05 discarded) => SELECTION BEATS MASS, the law falls; point-only exceedance feeds MIXED
bars.law_stands_bar_B: EVERY adversarial arm mean < random k=128 mean AND greedy-recency ratio <= 1.5x random-at-same-k at BOTH k=64 and k=128 => THE LAW STANDS with the recency rider (mass first-order, selection second-order)
bars.greedy: the k=16 adversarial-greedy oracle is REPORT-ONLY (no registered bar); k=128 'k+1' cross-reference = e089's stored k=200 random level (same battery, seed-89)

G3_protocol_identity_vs_e080.note: e101 has no static arm; G3 scope = control-battery identity (clean-judge per-seq vs e080 stored none arm) [e088/e089/e097's scoped G3 verbatim] — this ALSO gates that collect_att did not perturb the stream

e089.note: e089's uniform-subset curve (seed 89) — same battery (net/prompts/seed-7 control run); the k=16 and k=200 rungs bracket e101's arms

e097.note: e097's stratified thirds (seed 97): the recency gradient (new 2.2-2.8x) this experiment tries to weaponize into a full selection arm

greedy.note: report-only; anchored at pool-min (batchability restriction — conservative: a free greedy could also drop the anchor); run = the random-k64-max run (the adversarial direction)

registered_decision.verdict: No kill (no CI-backed exceedance of the random k=128 band +0.717 [+0.526,+0.912]), but the law-stands clauses do not both fire either: arms at/above the random k=128 band: k128_recency +1.585; greedy-recency exceeds 1.5x random-at-same-k (k=64: 7.27x, k=128: 2.21x) — the e097 recency modulation is stronger than the rider clause allows. Honest reading with the arm table; the greedy oracle (report-only): k=16 cost +0.066 on run 0 (e089 random k=16 -0.026, e101 random k=64 +0.094).

k128_cross_ref.note: descriptive: k=128 adversarial arms vs e089's stored k=200 random level (the k+1 rung of the mass ladder)
